entities.name: 2,4-Dihydroxy-3-methylacetophenone
observations: Decoded SELFIES canonical SMILES: CC(=O)C1=CC=C(O)C(C)=C1O; contains two phenolic OH groups and an acetyl group.
Acts as the likely acidic phenolic nucleophile in a Mitsunobu etherification.

entities.name: Heteroaryl benzyl alcohol
observations: Decoded SELFIES canonical SMILES: N#CC1=CN=CC(SC2=CC=CC(CO)=C2)=C1; contains a primary benzyl alcohol and a cyanopyridyl thioether substituent.
Acts as the likely alcohol substrate in the Mitsunobu reaction.

entities.name: Mitsunobu etherification
observations: Triphenylphosphine and diisopropyl azodicarboxylate in tetrahydrofuran are standard Mitsunobu conditions.
Expected transformation: phenolic O-alkylation of the benzyl alcohol, with loss of the alcohol OH group.
